definition: Says the session, or a named part of it, moved too fast to follow. Not used for wanting more content.
A problem that only affects people attending online: audio, seeing the room, questions being missed.
Wants more time, slower steps or more help on the hands-on exercise.
Asks for slides, files, the handout, more examples or a recording.
Says the content was pitched below or above what they needed.
Comments on the physical room or the running order: temperature, projector, breaks.
Positive comment with no request attached.
